concerns.text: Phase 9 (T090-T094) introduces a 'Rule Space Enumeration' to search 10-20 topological variants. This silently relaxes FR-003 (systematic ablation of specific features) and FR-004 (6-hour CPU limit for the *entire* project). The spec mandates testing a single canonical microcircuit against a baseline; expanding to an exhaustive search of 20 variants without a spec amendment violates the resource constraint and scope defined in FR-004 and the Plan's 'Scale/Scope' section.

Task T010b is marked [X] (complete) in the text but the description states it is 'REJECTED' and missing the required function. This creates a semantic contradiction where a task claiming to satisfy SC-002 (Training Stability) and FR-007 (Homeostatic Scaling) is functionally absent. The deliverable (log_gradient_norms) is missing, violating the acceptance criterion for SC-002.

Task T008c (polynomial test data) and T014 (generalization validation) are marked [ ] (incomplete). FR-006 and US-001 Acceptance Scenario 2 explicitly require validation on a statistically independent test set (polynomial surfaces). Without these tasks, the baseline validation is incomplete, and the project cannot proceed to US-002 (Microcircuit) as the control baseline is unverified. This is a silent relaxation of the 'Independent Distribution Validation' requirement.

Task T010c enforces the E/I ratio as a 'structural constraint (fixed connectivity)' and explicitly states it is 'NOT a dynamic per-batch target adjustment'. This contradicts FR-002 and Constitution Principle VI, which mandate a 'homeostatic scaling mechanism' to *dynamically* maintain the ratio during training. The task description admits to relaxing the dynamic feedback loop requirement to a static structural one, violating the biological constraint fidelity.
